SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fleet_store WHERE id='main' AND NOT (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN COALESCE((json_valid(payload) AND json_type(payload)='object' AND json_type(payload,'$.format') IS NULL AND json_type(payload,'$.formatVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(payload,'$.authorizationVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(payload,'$.accountSchemaVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(payload,'$.policyVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(payload,'$.security') IS NULL
 AND (json_type(payload,'$.accountFormatVersion') IS NULL OR (json_type(payload,'$.accountFormatVersion') IN ('integer','real') AND json_extract(payload,'$.accountFormatVersion')=1))
 AND json_type(payload,'$.cars')='array' AND json_type(payload,'$.people')='array' AND json_type(payload,'$.trips')='array' AND json_type(payload,'$.audit')='array' AND json_type(payload,'$.projects')='array'
 AND json_type(payload,'$.imported') IN ('true','false') AND (json_type(payload,'$.accounts') IS NULL OR json_type(payload,'$.accounts')='array')
 AND (json_type(payload,'$.sessionKey') IS NULL OR (json_type(payload,'$.sessionKey')='text' AND length(json_extract(payload,'$.sessionKey'))>0))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.people') p WHERE p.type<>'object' OR COALESCE(json_type(p.value,'$.id'),'missing')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(p.value,'$.id'))=0)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.accounts') a WHERE a.type<>'object' OR NOT COALESCE((
 json_type(a.value,'$.format') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.formatVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.accountFormatVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.authorizationVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.accountSchemaVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.policyVersion') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.status') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.approvalStatus') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.personId') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.accessRevision') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.origin') IS NULL AND json_type(a.value,'$.revision') IS NULL
 AND (json_type(a.value,'$.role') IS NULL OR (json_type(a.value,'$.role')='text' AND json_extract(a.value,'$.role') IN ('admin','employee')))
 AND json_type(a.value,'$.id')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.id'))>0 AND json_type(a.value,'$.username')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.username'))>0 AND json_type(a.value,'$.name')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.name'))>0 AND json_type(a.value,'$.salt')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.salt'))>0 AND json_type(a.value,'$.passwordHash')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.passwordHash'))>0 AND json_type(a.value,'$.driverId')='text' AND length(json_extract(a.value,'$.driverId'))>0
 AND json_extract(a.value,'$.id')<>'admin' AND json_extract(a.value,'$.username')<>'admin'
 AND json_type(a.value,'$.active') IN ('true','false')
 AND json_type(a.value,'$.passwordVersion') IN ('integer','real') AND json_extract(a.value,'$.passwordVersion') BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
 AND CAST(json_extract(a.value,'$.passwordVersion') AS INTEGER)=json_extract(a.value,'$.passwordVersion')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.people') p WHERE json_extract(p.value,'$.id')=json_extract(a.value,'$.driverId'))
 ),0))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.accounts') a GROUP BY json_extract(a.value,'$.id') HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.accounts') a GROUP BY json_extract(a.value,'$.username') HAVING COUNT(*)>1)),0) ELSE 0 END)) THEN 1 ELSE json('ACCOUNT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED') END
